ui_search34.meaning: Shared gallery search action button and generic search-field hint/caption. The same noun-style label can name the field and action. Query is trimmed, limited to512characters and empty query does nothing. Provider-specific behavior: Catrobat finds text in current WebView page; Openclipart navigates to search URL; Commons searches within Blank maps; Irasutoya submits its search form or reloads home with pending query.
complete_context: MediaGalleryActivity.kt: onCreate searchLabel, searchNow and onPageFinished pending search
IllustrationSource.kt: provider identities and home URLs
ui_search34.qualification: Not only remote internet search or only local search; no promise of results. Irasutoya field uses a separate Search in English or Japanese key, outside scope; common Search action is still this key. Vertical visible field caption branch is not proof Amharic takes that branch.

ui_gallery_back34.meaning: Content description of arrow navigation button. Click goes back in WebView history when possible; otherwise loads selected provider home. Arrow orientation follows horizontal layout direction.
complete_context: MediaGalleryActivity.kt: gallery_navigation backArrow and button callback
ui_gallery_back34.qualification: Not Undo, not close gallery or application, not always previous page because history-empty fallback loads home. Android system back handler is separate and may exit; do not transfer that meaning to this label. No spoken/accessibility acceptance is claimed.

ui_copy_all.meaning: Generic full-text copy command across three consumers. Gallery copies all nonblank stored document-credit texts joined with blank lines, or shows no-credit notice when empty. Save-options credits panel copies its complete supplied credit text. Legal/notices dialog copies the entire displayed text parameter, not just selected/visible viewport text.
ui_copy_all.qualification: Not Copy all images/files, not only image-credit text, not Select all, not transfer to remote recipient. Clipboard copy requests can fail; label is not completion guarantee. Does not itself save unsaved credit-editor drafts. Complete legal text is not being translated in this group.

ui_choose_location.meaning: Positive action in shared save/export/share options dialog. Validates filename, constructs SaveRequest with format/settings/name, invokes caller, then dismisses options. Caller launches Android ACTION_CREATE_DOCUMENT with MIME and suggested filename so user chooses output destination. Invalid name leaves form open with field error.
complete_context: SaveOptionsDialog.kt: show dialog positive callback, ExportNames.valid/withExtension
ui_choose_location.qualification: Location means file storage destination, not geographic location/device location access. It is not Save now: destination picker selection and encoding/write still follow. Preserve U+2026. No guarantee of chooser availability or save success.

limits: Static bounded source inspection only, no runtime/native-reader/rendering/accessibility certification.
